preview.tournamentOverview: Albany GC is a 7,400-yard par-72 layout that places a premium on ball-striking and scrambling. The course weights show SG Total 7%), SG Around-the-Green 6%), and SG Off-the-Tee 5%) as the dominant factors, rewarding players who hit fairways, control approaches, and save pars from off the green. The Hero World Challenge is a 20-man field with no cut, making every round count for both standings and betting.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model leans on SG Total, SG Around-the-Green, and SG Off-the-Tee because those three categories combine for 8% of the weighting. SG Approach 7%) and SG Putting 1%) still matter, but the course's forgiving greens and wide fairways mute their impact. Driving Accuracy 4%) and Bogey Avoidance 0%) round out the profile, emphasizing the need to stay out of trouble rather than bomb-and-gauge.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by model rank and course fit: top-five model names with strong SG Around-the-Green and SG Off-the-Tee numbers are our core outright and top-5 plays. Long-shot bets target players whose model rank is at least 15 spots better than their power rank and who post positive SG Around-the-Green marks.
